# ⚠️ nimsuper (Deprecated & Unmaintained)

> **IMPORTANT**: `nimsuper` is **no longer maintained**. The project has moved and been renamed to **[superoc](https://www.npmjs.com/package/superoc)**.

All new features, bug fixes, and multi-provider support (**NVIDIA NIM**, **Google Gemini**, **Google Cloud Code Antigravity OAuth**) are exclusively maintained in **[superoc](https://www.npmjs.com/package/superoc)**.

## Migration

```bash
npm uninstall -g nimsuper
npm install -g superoc
```

Update your OpenCode config (`~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc` or `opencode.json`):

```jsonc
{
  "plugin": ["superoc"]
}
```

- **Active npm Package**: [npmjs.com/package/superoc](https://www.npmjs.com/package/superoc)
